goodFor: a video in the style of a picture
limits: older model: Wan 2.2, LTX 2.5 or MiniMax H3 are better

wf:video_wan_vace_14B_t2v.what: Makes a video from words at 480p or 720p with Wan 2.1 VACE.
wf:video_wan_vace_14B_t2v.how: Wan 2.1 VACE 14B runs on Comfy Cloud and generates the clip from your words.
limits: older model: Wan 2.2, LTX 2.5 or MiniMax H3 are better

wf:video_wan_vace_14B_v2v.what: Makes a new video that follows the motion of your video and the look of a reference picture, with Wan 2.1 VACE.
wf:video_wan_vace_14B_v2v.how: On Comfy Cloud edges (Canny) are traced from your video and Wan 2.1 VACE draws a new clip along them in the style of your reference.
goodFor: keep the motion, change the look
limits: older model: Wan 2.2, LTX 2.5 or MiniMax H3 are better

wf:video_wan_vace_flf2v.what: Makes a video between a first and last frame, or through several keyframes, with Wan 2.1 VACE.
wf:video_wan_vace_flf2v.how: Wan 2.1 VACE runs on Comfy Cloud and fills the frames between your keyframes.
limits: older model: Wan 2.2, LTX 2.5 or MiniMax H3 are better

wf:video_wan_vace_inpainting.what: Removes or replaces something in a region of a video and keeps the rest, with Wan 2.1 VACE.
wf:video_wan_vace_inpainting.how: On Comfy Cloud the region is found (SAM3) or masked, and Wan 2.1 VACE re-draws it across the frames from your words.
goodFor: remove an object from a video

wf:video_wan_vace_outpainting.what: Extends a video beyond its edges (a wider or taller frame), with Wan 2.1 VACE.
wf:video_wan_vace_outpainting.how: On Comfy Cloud each frame is padded and Wan 2.1 VACE draws the new area across the clip.

wf:wan2.1_flf2v_720_f16.what: Makes a 720p video between a first and a last frame with Wan 2.1 FLF2V.
wf:wan2.1_flf2v_720_f16.how: Wan 2.1 FLF2V runs on Comfy Cloud and generates the motion between your two pictures.
limits: older model: Wan 2.2, LTX 2.5 or MiniMax H3 are better

wf:wan2.1_fun_control.what: Makes a video that follows the pose, depth or edges of another video, with Wan 2.1 Fun Control.
wf:wan2.1_fun_control.how: On Comfy Cloud a control video is traced from your clip and Wan 2.1 Fun Control draws along it.
goodFor: restyle a video keeping its motion
limits: older model: Wan 2.2, LTX 2.5 or MiniMax H3 are better

wf:wan2.1_fun_inp.what: Makes a video between a start and an end frame with Wan 2.1 Fun InP.
wf:wan2.1_fun_inp.how: Wan 2.1 Fun InP runs on Comfy Cloud and fills the frames between your two pictures.
limits: older model: Wan 2.2, LTX 2.5 or MiniMax H3 are better
